Offer and promotion messages in chat share a deal at the moment it is useful, with the terms stated clearly. Ecom Swift LLC sets the rules, writes the wording and connects real discount codes from your store, then tests each offer from first message to checkout.

## What are offer messages in chat?

Offer messages are short notes from your sales assistant that mention a deal when a shopper is likely to care about it. Examples include a first order discount for a new visitor, a free shipping reminder when the cart is nearly there, or a sale on the collection someone is browsing.

The key idea is timing. A banner shown to everyone all the time is easy to ignore. A message shown at the right point, to the right person, with the right limits, is read.

## Why do the timing and honesty of an offer matter?

An offer that appears too early trains shoppers to wait for it. One that appears too often feels like pressure. One with unclear terms creates support messages and, worse, a sense of being tricked when the discount fails at checkout.

Honest terms protect your brand. When the end date, the minimum spend and any exclusions are visible in the message, the shopper knows what to expect. When the code is real and works, trust grows instead of falling.

## How well timed offers affect orders

The mechanism is relevance. A free shipping reminder helps a shopper who is a little short of the threshold. A welcome offer helps a first time visitor who is hesitating. A collection sale helps someone already looking at those products. Each one answers a specific reason to hold back.

Frequency limits matter just as much, because they keep the assistant from nagging. Reporting shows which offers were seen, used and ordered, so you can drop the ones that do nothing. We cannot promise any particular lift, since price, margin and product mix all influence the result. We make sure the offers behave correctly and can be measured.

## What good offer messages include

- Wording that states the benefit in the first few words.
- A real discount code or automatic discount from your store.
- Terms and an end date shown in the message.
- Triggers based on page, collection or cart value.
- A limit on how often one visitor sees an offer.
- Different offers for new and returning visitors.
- A phone friendly layout that does not cover the product.
- A calendar for seasonal offers, planned ahead.
- Checks that the code stops working when the offer ends.
- A report of offer use and the orders linked to it.

## How we set it up

We begin with your margins and goals, because an offer that loses money on every order is not a plan. We choose which offers to run, which triggers fit them and how often visitors may see them.

Then we create or connect the discount codes in your store, write the messages and set the limits. We test each offer as a new visitor and a returning one, on phone and desktop, from the first chat message through to a paid order. Basic covers one offer with a real code and clear terms. Standard adds more offers, triggers by page or cart value and frequency limits. Premium adds offers by visitor type, a seasonal calendar and reporting.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Show the end date and conditions beside every offer.
- Match each offer to a specific shopper situation.
- Cap how many times one visitor sees a message.
- Test the discount code at checkout before launch.
- Switch off offers that no longer apply.

**Avoid:**
- Showing the same discount to every visitor at all times.
- Letting the assistant invent its own codes or terms.
- Inflating a price just to cross it out.
- Leaving an expired offer in the chat.
- Stacking offers that cancel your margin.

## Who this is for

This suits a store that runs regular promotions and wants them delivered with care. It suits a new brand that wants a clear welcome offer for first time visitors. It also suits a seller with a free shipping threshold who wants shoppers to notice how close they are.

## What we need from you

Tell us the offers you plan to run, the limits you want, the products or collections involved and the dates. Share your tone of voice and any terms you must include.

We work inside your own store and never ask for passwords. Access is given as a collaborator or staff user, and you can remove it whenever you wish. After you order, we send a short checklist and let you review every message before it is live.
